command:
echo '=== SOURCE (snapshot) ==='
[ -e '/btrfs/volume1/mac/#snapshot/a.txt' ] || { echo "ERROR: source does not exist"; exit 1; }
echo '=== DESTINATION ==='
ls -la '/btrfs/volume1/mac/a.txt' 2>/dev/null && echo "EXISTS — refusing to overwrite" && exit 1 || echo "(does not exist — safe to restore)"
echo '=== RESTORING ==='
cp -a '/btrfs/volume1/mac/#snapshot/a.txt' '/btrfs/volume1/mac/a.txt' 2>&1 || { echo "FAILED to restore"; exit 1; }
echo '=== VERIFY ==='
ls -la '/btrfs/volume1/mac/a.txt' 2>&1

echo '=== TARGET WORKTREE ROOT ==='
[ -d '/btrfs/volume1/mac/Art Library' ] || { echo 'ERROR: not a directory: /btrfs/volume1/mac/Art Library'; exit 1; }
ls -la '/btrfs/volume1/mac/Art Library/seafile-ignore.txt' 2>/dev/null && echo '(existing ignore file will be OVERWRITTEN)' || echo '(no existing ignore file)'
echo '=== WRITING seafile-ignore.txt ==='
printf '%s\n' '@eaDir' '#recycle' '#snapshot' '@tmp' '.DS_Store' 'Thumbs.db' '*@SynoEAStream' '*@SynoResource' '*.tmp' > '/btrfs/volume1/mac/Art Library/seafile-ignore.txt'
echo '=== VERIFY ==='
cat '/btrfs/volume1/mac/Art Library/seafile-ignore.txt'

echo '=== TARGET WORKTREE ROOT ==='
[ -d '/btrfs/volume1/mac/x$(touch /tmp/OWNED)' ] || { echo 'ERROR: not a directory: /btrfs/volume1/mac/x$(touch /tmp/OWNED)'; exit 1; }
ls -la '/btrfs/volume1/mac/x$(touch /tmp/OWNED)/seafile-ignore.txt' 2>/dev/null && echo '(existing ignore file will be OVERWRITTEN)' || echo '(no existing ignore file)'
echo '=== WRITING seafile-ignore.txt ==='
printf '%s\n' '@eaDir' '#recycle' '#snapshot' '@tmp' '.DS_Store' 'Thumbs.db' '*@SynoEAStream' '*@SynoResource' '*.tmp' > '/btrfs/volume1/mac/x$(touch /tmp/OWNED)/seafile-ignore.txt'
echo '=== VERIFY ==='
cat '/btrfs/volume1/mac/x$(touch /tmp/OWNED)/seafile-ignore.txt'

echo '=== CREATING PRECHANGE SNAPSHOT: /btrfs/volume1 ==='
ts=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
snap='/btrfs/volume1'"/@prechange_${ts}"
btrfs subvolume snapshot -r '/btrfs/volume1' "$snap" 2>&1 && echo "Snapshot created: $snap" || echo 'Snapshot FAILED — btrfs mount at /btrfs/volumeN needed (see docker-compose.agent.yml)'

echo '=== CREATING PRECHANGE SNAPSHOT: /btrfs/volume1$(touch /tmp/OWNED) ==='
ts=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
snap='/btrfs/volume1$(touch /tmp/OWNED)'"/@prechange_${ts}"
btrfs subvolume snapshot -r '/btrfs/volume1$(touch /tmp/OWNED)' "$snap" 2>&1 && echo "Snapshot created: $snap" || echo 'Snapshot FAILED — btrfs mount at /btrfs/volumeN needed (see docker-compose.agent.yml)'

echo '=== STARTING BTRFS SCRUB: /btrfs/volume1 ==='
btrfs scrub start '/btrfs/volume1' 2>&1
echo ''
echo '=== SCRUB STATUS ==='
btrfs scrub status '/btrfs/volume1' 2>&1

echo '=== STARTING BTRFS SCRUB: /btrfs/volume1$(touch /tmp/OWNED) ==='
btrfs scrub start '/btrfs/volume1$(touch /tmp/OWNED)' 2>&1
echo ''
echo '=== SCRUB STATUS ==='
btrfs scrub status '/btrfs/volume1$(touch /tmp/OWNED)' 2>&1

echo '=== Triggering ShareSync re-sync for folder: mac ==='
echo "Restarting SynologyDriveShareSync to force full re-sync of all tasks"
echo ""
if [ -z "${DSM_USERNAME:-}" ] || [ -z "${DSM_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then echo "ERROR: DSM_USERNAME/DSM_PASSWORD not set in .env — required for WebAPI package restarts"; exit 1; fi
DSM_BASE="http://localhost:${DSM_PORT:-5000}/webapi/entry.cgi"
echo "=== Authenticating to DSM WebAPI ==="
SID=$(curl -sfG "$DSM_BASE" --data-urlencode "api=SYNO.API.Auth" --data-urlencode "version=7" --data-urlencode "method=login" --data-urlencode "account=${DSM_USERNAME}" --data-urlencode "passwd=${DSM_PASSWORD}" --data-urlencode "format=sid" 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"sid":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
if [ -z "$SID" ]; then echo "ERROR: DSM login failed — check DSM_USERNAME/DSM_PASSWORD and that DSM is reachable on port ${DSM_PORT:-5000}"; exit 1; fi
echo "Authenticated to DSM"
echo ""
echo "=== Stopping SynologyDriveShareSync via SYNO.Core.Package method=stop ==="
STOP=$(curl -sfG "$DSM_BASE" --data-urlencode "api=SYNO.Core.Package" --data-urlencode "version=1" --data-urlencode "method=stop" --data-urlencode "id=SynologyDriveShareSync" --data-urlencode "_sid=$SID" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$STOP"
echo "$STOP" | grep -q '"success":true' && echo "Stop: OK" || echo "Stop: non-success (package may already be stopped)"
echo ""
sleep 4
echo "=== Starting SynologyDriveShareSync via SYNO.Core.Package method=start ==="
START=$(curl -sfG "$DSM_BASE" --data-urlencode "api=SYNO.Core.Package" --data-urlencode "version=1" --data-urlencode "method=start" --data-urlencode "id=SynologyDriveShareSync" --data-urlencode "_sid=$SID" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$START"
echo "$START" | grep -q '"success":true' && echo "Start: OK" || echo "Start: non-success — check DSM Package Center for errors"
echo ""
curl -sfG "$DSM_BASE" --data-urlencode "api=SYNO.API.Auth" --data-urlencode "version=7" --data-urlencode "method=logout" --data-urlencode "_sid=$SID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
echo "Session closed"

echo '=== Triggering ShareSync re-sync for folder: mac$(touch /tmp/OWNED) ==='
echo "Restarting SynologyDriveShareSync to force full re-sync of all tasks"
echo ""
if [ -z "${DSM_USERNAME:-}" ] || [ -z "${DSM_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then echo "ERROR: DSM_USERNAME/DSM_PASSWORD not set in .env — required for WebAPI package restarts"; exit 1; fi
DSM_BASE="http://localhost:${DSM_PORT:-5000}/webapi/entry.cgi"
echo "=== Authenticating to DSM WebAPI ==="
SID=$(curl -sfG "$DSM_BASE" --data-urlencode "api=SYNO.API.Auth" --data-urlencode "version=7" --data-urlencode "method=login" --data-urlencode "account=${DSM_USERNAME}" --data-urlencode "passwd=${DSM_PASSWORD}" --data-urlencode "format=sid" 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"sid":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
if [ -z "$SID" ]; then echo "ERROR: DSM login failed — check DSM_USERNAME/DSM_PASSWORD and that DSM is reachable on port ${DSM_PORT:-5000}"; exit 1; fi
echo "Authenticated to DSM"
echo ""
echo "=== Stopping SynologyDriveShareSync via SYNO.Core.Package method=stop ==="
STOP=$(curl -sfG "$DSM_BASE" --data-urlencode "api=SYNO.Core.Package" --data-urlencode "version=1" --data-urlencode "method=stop" --data-urlencode "id=SynologyDriveShareSync" --data-urlencode "_sid=$SID" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$STOP"
echo "$STOP" | grep -q '"success":true' && echo "Stop: OK" || echo "Stop: non-success (package may already be stopped)"
echo ""
sleep 4
echo "=== Starting SynologyDriveShareSync via SYNO.Core.Package method=start ==="
START=$(curl -sfG "$DSM_BASE" --data-urlencode "api=SYNO.Core.Package" --data-urlencode "version=1" --data-urlencode "method=start" --data-urlencode "id=SynologyDriveShareSync" --data-urlencode "_sid=$SID" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$START"
echo "$START" | grep -q '"success":true' && echo "Start: OK" || echo "Start: non-success — check DSM Package Center for errors"
echo ""
curl -sfG "$DSM_BASE" --data-urlencode "api=SYNO.API.Auth" --data-urlencode "version=7" --data-urlencode "method=logout" --data-urlencode "_sid=$SID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
echo "Session closed"

echo '=== RESTARTING NETWORK SERVICE: smb ==='
echo ''
echo '--- trying synopkg restart ---'
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/host/lib:/host/usr/lib:/host/usr/syno/lib /host/usr/syno/bin/synopkg restart 'smb' 2>/dev/null && echo 'synopkg restart succeeded' || echo 'synopkg: not a DSM package or restart failed (gcompat required in nas-api image)'
echo ''
echo '--- trying pkill/respawn for service processes ---'
pkill -SIGTERM -x 'smbd' 2>&1 && echo 'SIGTERM sent to smbd (DSM will respawn)' || echo 'smbd: process not found'
echo ''
echo '=== SERVICE PROCESSES AFTER RESTART (2s delay) ==='
sleep 2
ps aux | grep -iE 'smb' | grep -v grep | head -10 || echo 'No matching processes found'

echo '=== RESTARTING NETWORK SERVICE: smb$(touch /tmp/OWNED) ==='
echo ''
echo '--- trying synopkg restart ---'
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/host/lib:/host/usr/lib:/host/usr/syno/lib /host/usr/syno/bin/synopkg restart 'smb$(touch /tmp/OWNED)' 2>/dev/null && echo 'synopkg restart succeeded' || echo 'synopkg: not a DSM package or restart failed (gcompat required in nas-api image)'
echo ''
echo '--- trying pkill/respawn for service processes ---'
pkill -SIGTERM -x 'smb$(touch /tmp/OWNED)' 2>&1 && echo 'SIGTERM sent to smb$(touch /tmp/OWNED) (DSM will respawn)' || echo 'smb$(touch /tmp/OWNED): process not found'
echo ''
echo '=== SERVICE PROCESSES AFTER RESTART (2s delay) ==='
sleep 2
ps aux | grep -iE 'smb$(touch /tmp/OWNED)' | grep -v grep | head -10 || echo 'No matching processes found'
